research_notes: Research includes parliamentary biography, primary employer CV and public appointment post, contemporaneous law-firm publication, conference profile, public professional index, reliable appointment news, historical government-control records, council authority annual report and register reproduction.
Public/private employers both present; full-time status not supplied by senior titles, overall twenty-year summaries or five-year rounded ASC statement. No calculated headline totals.

Remaining gaps: first employer(s) 2005–2008; separate overseas firm dates; ASC legal entity and hours; Boeing/Sparke/LK transition; leave and overlap; teaching contracts and Leo Cussen legal status; RFDS start and primary resignation forms.

Direct LinkedIn profile returned 999; Al Tamimi PDF exceeded tool length; APH interests PDF restricted. Public employer announcement and indexed/secondary narrow facts were accessible. No access controls bypassed.
Searches for full-time work returned staff vacancy advertisements, not evidence about this member. Those advertisements were not used.
